## Before connecting the controller

- [ ] Exact board model and Linux image recorded.
- [ ] Exact header pins or GPIO lines verified.
- [ ] Sensor/module schematic or manufacturer documentation checked.
- [ ] Pull-up voltage checked; no hidden 5 V pull-up reaches 3.3 V GPIO.
- [ ] Analogue worst-case voltage calculated below the exact ADC limit.
- [ ] Unconnected interface voltage measured with a multimeter.
- [ ] High-current or inductive load uses a suitable driver.
- [ ] Flyback protection installed where required.
- [ ] Fuse/current limit and safe state identified.
